title: feat(roadmap): a comment by a person on an item starts a suspended row again
summary: The plan of pull request #3167, which the stage job opened and a person closed. Every text of the plan is the placeholder `x`, and the one `verify` command is `true`. No gate of the job refused it when it was staged (#3200).
notes: The pull request was never merged. The plan is the change folder at the head commit of the pull request, and `merge_commit` holds that commit.
The scores are the lowest, set by hand: the plan has no premise check, no task and no usable text.

defects.problem: Why, What Changes, Feasibility and Existing Tool Considered each hold only `x`. The plan says nothing that an implement job can use, and it checks no premise.
defects.evidence: proposal.md of the head commit of pull request #3167: `## Why` is `x`, `## Feasibility` is `- x`, `## Existing Tool Considered` is `x`.
defects.message: The text of why is the placeholder

defects.problem: The only verify command is `true`, which passes on each run. It proves nothing about the change.
defects.evidence: tasks.md of the head commit of pull request #3167: `1.1 x, and verify that `true` passes`.
